verdict.rationale: Grafana's docs cover collection and storage for all three signals: Alloy and OpenTelemetry ingestion, Mimir for metrics, Loki for logs and Tempo for traces. Pivoting with shared context is documented as switching from metrics to logs with preserved label filters, exemplar jumps from metrics to Tempo traces, Tempo linking traces with logs and metrics, and Knowledge Graph and incident workflows that connect all three. A community user independently confirms getting metrics, logs and tracing together in Grafana Cloud. One early hands-on report of trouble finding log exploration in the hosted instance points to UX friction, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the cross-signal pivot workflows (e.g., trace-to-log navigation in practice).
